resources.string: Shows while this phone is the Monitor, with a button to stop.
Waiting for a viewer. The camera is off until someone watches.
Someone is watching. The camera and microphone are on.

This phone will use its camera and microphone to stream your pet to your other phone. It keeps monitoring with the screen off, with a notification showing, until you tap Stop. The camera and microphone are on only while someone is watching. The video and sound are sent encrypted, directly between your devices, and are never recorded or stored anywhere.
